name: 33913 · Fort Myers, FL
findings: ZIP 33913 (Fort Myers) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33913 (Fort Myers) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33913 (Fort Myers) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
